headline: Project brief — Website relaunch goals and success metrics
body: Public site redesign with new IA, performance budget under 2s LCP, and conversion lift target of 12% on pricing.
author: Ken Manager

headline: Spec — pricing page wireframes and component inventory
body: Sections: hero, plan comparison, FAQ accordion, sticky CTA; design tokens from design-system v3 only.
author: Sam Member

headline: Proposal — phased IA migration without SEO cliff
body: Redirect map for top 40 URLs, staged cutover by section, rollback window of 72h with traffic shadowing.
author: Ken Manager

headline: Status report — sprint 12 funnel map and drop-off fixes
body: Mapped drop-off at pricing CTA; shipped sticky CTA A/B; conversion +4.1% week over week on desktop.
author: Sam Member

headline: Decision — freeze marketing homepage copy until launch week
body: No further homepage copy churn after 20 Jul freeze; all requests go through launch checklist owner.
author: Ken Manager

headline: Project brief — Mobile app beta for field agents
body: iOS/Android beta for field agents: offline task capture, photo evidence, and push for review handoffs.
author: Ken Manager

headline: Spec — offline sync conflict resolution for task updates
body: Last-writer-wins on status; merge notes by append; photo uploads queue until connectivity with retry backoff.
author: Sam Member

headline: Proposal — TestFlight then staged Play Internal track
body: Twenty internal testers first week; expand to fifty after crash-free sessions exceed 99.5% for three days.
author: Ken Manager

headline: Status report — beta week 2 crash rate and onboarding drop
body: Crash-free 99.7%; onboarding drop at permissions screen fixed by pre-prompt education card.
author: Sam Member

headline: Decision — require manager review before public beta invite
body: No public TestFlight links until manager signs review checklist including offline smoke and PII scrub.
author: Ken Manager

headline: Spec draft — design token migration checklist for relaunch
body: Inventory legacy hex values, map to tokens, ban new raw colors in PR template until migration complete.
author: Sam Member

headline: Brief addendum — field photo retention and export policy
body: Photos retained 90 days on device cache; server retention follows task archive policy; export only via manager role.
author: Ken Manager
